newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen weaker at market open.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen weaker at market open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to weaken at the market open on Monday, as investors remained cautious about the possibility of higher rates after strong economic data triggered steep declines in markets on Friday.

"We should open on the soft side," Alan Ackerman, chief market strategist at Fahnestock & Co, said. "We are in for a bit of a breather, partly due to concerns about stronger economic growth in the second half of the year, which could prompt interest rates to rise."
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was off three points at 950. The long bond fell 13/32 to 6.48 percent.
